golfCanadaRatedYardages.description: Golf Canada's course-rating record for this facility. Tee names, par per hole, stroke index and every rating/slope match the club card; the per-hole yardages are the rating team's measured values and run slightly shorter than the printed card.

notes: PRIMARY SOURCE: the club's own scorecard image published at innerkiphighlands.com/golf/scorecard (/images/2021_Scorecard_Pg1.jpg = course map, Pg2.jpg = the card). All five tee rows were transcribed and every row sums exactly to the printed OUT / IN / TOTAL, par sums 36/36/72, and the stroke index is a clean permutation of 1-18 with all odd numbers on the front nine and all even on the back. Single 18-hole course - no second course or nine to conflate. CROSS-CHECK: Golf Canada's facility record independently confirms the same five tee names (Blue/Orange/White/Yellow/Red), the identical par for all 18 holes, the identical stroke index (for Blue/Orange/White and all women's tees), and every course rating and slope printed on the card. DISAGREEMENT 1 - yardage basis: Golf Canada's per-hole yardages are its rating-measured values and are systematically a little shorter (Blue 6355 vs the card's 6432). Kept the club's printed numbers as the scorecard values; Golf Canada's are preserved under crossCheck.golfCanadaRatedYardages. DISAGREEMENT 2 - stale aggregators: Offcourse, Golfify, GolfPass and GolfLink all publish Blue 6417 / OUT 3186 with hole 3 at 385. That is the club's PREVIOUS card (archived 2018 copy confirms Blue 6417, OUT 3186, hole 3 = 385, Men's Blue 70.0/125). The club lengthened hole 3 to 400 and reworked 13/15 in the current card. Offcourse and Golfify additionally invent 'Blue/White' and 'White/Red' combo tees that do not exist on any club card, and Golfify's Blue row scrambles holes 3 and 4. These aggregators were not treated as corroboration. CAVEAT - hole 3 Yellow: the card prints 238, which is shorter than Red's 280 on the same hole and looks like a possible transposition of the previous card's 283. It is recorded as printed because the card's own Yellow OUT total (2504) only balances with 238; Golf Canada lists 280 for Yellow on hole 3. CAVEAT - Red men's rating: not printed on the club card (Red is shown only as a ladies' tee, 67.8/118). The men's Red 63.3/105 in teeSets comes from Golf Canada only. Golf Canada in turn has no women's Orange tee, so the ladies' Orange 74.9/134 comes from the club card only. Card also states: all yardages measured to centre of green; fairway markers Gold 250 / Blue 200 / White 150 / Red 100; pin positions Blue back, White middle, Red front.
